title: What Happens If You Rest Your Hand on the Gear Shifter

script.narration: Stop resting your hand there. Leaving it on the shifter while driving causes expensive damage.
script.visual_search: hand resting on manual gear shifter inside car

script.narration: The weight pushes internal selector forks against rotating collars. Over time, this constant friction wears down the metal components inside the transmission.
script.visual_search: car manual transmission gears close up mechanism

script.narration: Keep both hands on the wheel. Like if this helped, and comment your biggest driving habit below.
